2016.note:
linkC re-selected post-estimator-change (D-Q2, quick task 260901-is2): coarse grid 0.2/0.3/0.4/0.5/0.7/1.0/1.24/1.5/2/3 selected on TUNE seasons 2022-2024 only, exactly how the promoted set was chosen; holdout quals Brier equal (0.1551), holdout elims Brier better (0.1596 -> 0.1580). Every OTHER parameter in this set was tuned against the RETIRED residual-history R estimator and is stale. A full re-tune under the innovation-based estimator is DEFERRED; the recorded objective describes the search winner, not this set.

covShrinkage restored to its documented constant 0.3 (D-T3, quick task 260901-trz). It is the PSD safeguard for subsetVariance's group-spread quadratic form, not a modelling knob: the sensitivity screen's optimum for it sat AT THE 0 BOUND, i.e. the search was trading the positive-semi-definiteness guarantee away for roughly 0.0005 Brier, an objective that is structurally blind to the failure the safeguard prevents. It is now named in searchSpace.ts's SEARCH_EXCLUSIONS with that reasoning, so this value is FIXED rather than tuned. Lineage note, since derivedFromVersion below is same-version and therefore records only this step: this parameter set descends from vpr@3.0.0+tuned-2026-08 via the sigma1-3.0.0-absolute-to-4.0.0-scale-relative shape migration (D-T1/D-T2). Every OTHER parameter here was searched under the retired ABSOLUTE parameterization and is stale pending the rolling-origin re-tune (D-T5).

varianceOprRidge corrected 10 -> 2 (260902-varopr Task 6): 10 was selected on the FULL-SEASON recovery table while the solve is EVENT-scoped, and at event scope implied an effective league weight of 0.502 - HEAVIER than the 0.400 empirical-Bayes blend the user rejected. 2 holds league weight to 0.174 and maximises slope (0.785). Display-only: the prediction stream is unchanged.

provenance.objectiveDefinition: each season's own paramSetsBySeason entry's `objective` number is that entry's SOURCE search's PRIMARY objective value AT THE TIME that search ran — see objectiveDefinition.ts's SEARCH_OBJECTIVE_DEFINITION for the current (accuracy-primary/Brier-secondary) rule, and that entry's own selectedOnSeasons/sourceArtifact for which seasons and which search produced it
